shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S.-Iran military conflict continued on the 5th, with the U.S. saying it struck three Iranian tankers, while Iran said U.S. forces attacked three Iranian tankers out of desperation over the Strait of Hormuz being blocked and caused damage.

title: U.S.-Iran Military Conflict Continues as Both Sides Report Attacks on Tankers
